title: Matching puncture marks examined by Dr Margo

tellings.quote: and they're exactly the same depth and this and the same size

plain: In 2019 on St. Simons Island, Georgia, puncture marks on the body of someone who reports being taken by non-human beings were examined by a doctor named Dr Margo, who is said to have found them "exactly the same depth" and the same size. Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site who describes his own abduction, relays what the doctor told him. The matching marks are offered as physical evidence that something was done to him.
